caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular base and angled feet. The upper portion of the chest is decorated with ornate, symmetrical floral and geometric patterns in shades of blue, red, and pale yellow on a brown background. The front of the chest features two large, arch-shaped decorative panels with stylized floral motifs and small circular and teardrop-shaped accents. Below these are three drawers, the leftmost drawer having a round knob, while the other two have horizontal handles and keyholes. The sides of the chest are similarly adorned with floral designs that echo the front panels. There is a smaller schematic section beneath the chest showing technical dimensions and details. The entire drawing is framed by a cream-colored border on a slightly darker beige background.
title: Pa. German Chest
